Develop and execute boutique action plans to drive sustainable growth. Monitor team performance and implement corrective actions when required. 4304f3fc48ab3285.job_title: Principal Consultant – Enterprise Architecture & Digital Transformation
4304f3fc48ab3285.description: Role Purpose EjadTech is seeking a highly experienced Principal Enterprise Architect & Digital Transformation Expert to lead strategic consulting engagements in enterprise architecture and digital transformation across government and private-sector organizations in Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on establishing and developing Enterprise Architecture (EA) Offices, conducting architecture and digital maturity assessments, developing digital transformation strategies and roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with national frameworks and regulatory requirements, including NORA, TOGAF, and the Digital Government Authority (DGA). The successful candidate will also play a key role in business development by engaging directly with clients, identifying and evaluating strategic opportunities, shaping consulting solutions, and supporting the development of competitive technical proposals and new advisory service offerings. Key Responsibilities 1. Enterprise Architecture Consulting & Advisory Lead and deliver enterprise architecture consulting engagements across government and private-sector organizations. Establish, develop, and operationalize Enterprise Architecture (EA) Offices, including governance frameworks, operating models, policies, processes, and procedures. Apply NORA, TOGAF, and relevant national and international enterprise architecture standards and best practices. Lead the development of Business, Data, Application, and Technology Architectures. Align enterprise architecture strategies and initiatives with organizational objectives, digital transformation strategies, and DGA requirements. Develop target-state architectures, transformation roadmaps, and strategic recommendations to enhance enterprise capabilities and technology alignment. 2. Digital Transformation Strategy & Advisory Lead digital transformation consulting engagements, including strategy development, digital maturity assessments, and transformation roadmap design. Assess organizational digital capabilities, operating models, processes, and technology environments to identify transformation opportunities. Develop digital transformation strategies, initiatives, and implementation roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities and national digital frameworks. Advise clients on digital governance, operating models, process optimization, and technology-enabled business transformation. Apply relevant DGA, SDAIA, NDMO, and other applicable national digital transformation frameworks, standards, and indicators. Define transformation priorities, performance indicators, and improvement initiatives to support measurable business outcomes. 3. EA & Digital Maturity Assessment and Governance Lead enterprise architecture and digital maturity assessments using applicable national frameworks, assessment models, and international best practices. Conduct current-state and target-state assessments, gap analyses, and organizational capability evaluations. Develop maturity improvement plans, compliance roadmaps, and governance enhancement initiatives. Establish KPIs and measurement mechanisms to monitor enterprise architecture effectiveness, digital transformation progress, and maturity improvement. Assess organizational alignment with DGA requirements and relevant national digital transformation standards. Present assessment findings, strategic recommendations, and improvement plans to executive management and key stakeholders. 4. Business Development & Client Engagement Identify and support strategic business development opportunities in enterprise architecture and digital transformation consulting across government and private-sector markets. Engage directly with clients and executive stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify transformation needs, and provide expert advisory recommendations. Lead the technical and consulting evaluation of potential opportunities, including feasibility, scope, delivery approach, and alignment with EjadTech's capabilities. Contribute to developing and expanding enterprise architecture and digital transformation consulting services based on market demands and emerging trends. Support the development of technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOW), consulting methodologies, deliverables, and resource estimates. Collaborate with sales, business development, and delivery teams to qualify opportunities, shape consulting solutions, and ensure effective transition from proposal to execution. 5. Technical Architecture & Solution Advisory Provide expert architectural guidance across software engineering, solution architecture, cloud computing, IT infrastructure, and systems integration. Evaluate enterprise applications, technology platforms, and proposed solutions against target architecture and digital transformation requirements. Recommend appropriate technologies, architectural approaches, and integration strategies to address client business needs. Advise on emerging technologies and their potential applications in enterprise modernization and digital transformation. Ensure architectural recommendations support scalability, interoperability, security, and alignment with business and transformation objectives. Qualifications & Requirements Education & Professional Experience Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in IT and consulting, including at least 5 years specializing in Enterprise Architecture and/or Digital Transformation . Proven experience leading enterprise architecture and digital transformation consulting projects. Demonstrated hands-on experience in establishing, developing, and operationalizing Enterprise Architecture (EA) Offices. Strong experience conducting enterprise architecture and digital maturity assessments, developing improvement roadmaps, and implementing governance frameworks. Proven experience developing digital transformation strategies, operating models, and implementation roadmaps. Previous consulting experience with Saudi government entities and strong familiarity with national digital transformation requirements. Experience supporting business development, evaluating consulting opportunities, engaging directly with clients, and preparing technical proposals and Statements of Work. Technical & Consulting Expertise In-depth knowledge of NORA , DGA requirements, and Saudi national enterprise architecture and digital transformation frameworks. Advanced expertise in TOGAF, enterprise architecture methodologies, governance models, and maturity assessment frameworks. Strong knowledge of digital transformation strategies, digital maturity models, operating models, and performance measurement frameworks. Familiarity with SDAIA, NDMO, and relevant national digital governance and data management requirements. Strong understanding of Business, Data, Application, and Technology Architecture domains. Solid technical background in software engineering, solution architecture, cloud platforms, IT infrastructure, and enterprise systems integration. Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into practical architecture and digital transformation solutions. Professional Certifications Mandatory TOGAF Certification. Preferred AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert. Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect. Professional certifications in Digital Transformation, Digital Strategy, or IT Governance. Equivalent professional certifications in cloud architecture, solution architecture, or related IT disciplines. Core Competencies Strategic thinking and advanced consulting capabilities in enterprise architecture and digital transformation. 437151c003ab3455.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مصور فوتوغرافي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المصور مسؤولية تجهيز معدات التصوير، والتقاط الصور لمختلف المناظر والأحداث، بالإضافة إلى معالجة الصور وإعداد التقارير الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تجهيز كاميرات التصوير الفوتوغرافي والرقمي وجميع الأدوات والمعدات اللازمة. دراسة وتحليل موضوع الصورة وموقع التقاطها وظروف الإضاءة المحيطة. اختيار الكاميرا المناسبة وضبط عوامل التصوير مثل المسافة وفتحة العدسة واتجاه وزاوية التصوير. تصوير المناظر الطبيعية، الأشخاص، الأحداث، والمناسبات المختلفة. القيام بعمليات تحميض وتظهير الصور الفوتوغرافية التقليدية. معالجة الصور الرقمية باستخدام برامج الحاسب الآلي وطباعتها بجودة عالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصوير الفوتوغرافي. القدرة على استخدام أنواع مختلفة من الكاميرات الفوتوغرافية والرقمية. معرفة بأساسيات التصوير الفوتوغرافي وتقنياته. إتقان استخدام برامج معالجة الصور الرقمية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المصور ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتاح له الفرصة لتطبيق مهاراته في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

43d09b9ee2a8db82.description: The Assistant Manager – Trade Marketing is responsible for developing and executing trade marketing strategies that drive awareness, demand, conversion, and commercial performance across Qiddiya's destinations, attractions, experiences, and campaigns. The role supports the creation of compelling consumer propositions, go-to-market plans, promotional campaigns, and partner activation programs to maximize visitation, revenue generation, and return on marketing investment. Working closely with Destination Marketing, Commercial, Sales, Partnerships, Loyalty, Digital Marketing, and Operations teams, the role ensures marketing initiatives effectively reach target audiences and deliver measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Trade Marketing Strategy & Execution Support the development and execution of trade marketing strategies aligned with business and destination objectives. Plan and execute marketing activities across trade partners, distributors, travel operators, ticketing platforms, and promotional channels. Develop trade activation plans to drive demand generation, lead conversion, and visitation growth. Ensure marketing programs effectively support seasonal campaigns, destination launches, events, and new product offerings. Go-to-Market Planning Develop and execute integrated go-to-market plans for destination experiences, attractions, promotions, and new offerings. Coordinate cross-functional launch activities with Marketing, Commercial, Digital, Partnerships, and Operations teams. Support market segmentation and audience targeting strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness. Ensure timely delivery of marketing assets, promotional content, and activation materials. Offer & Promotional Marketing Develop and manage promotional campaigns, special offers, packages, and value-added propositions. Work closely with commercial stakeholders to create compelling offers that drive acquisition and conversion. Monitor promotion performance and recommend enhancements to maximize revenue and customer uptake. Support pricing and packaging initiatives from a marketing and customer proposition perspective. Consumer Proposition Development Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define and enhance destination, attraction, and entertainment propositions. Translate consumer insights into compelling and differentiated marketing messages. Ensure customer propositions align with target audience needs, preferences, and market demand. Support the development of customer value propositions across various audience segments. Demand Generation & Conversion Optimization Implement trade marketing programs designed to increase awareness, consideration, bookings, and visitation. Monitor customer journey performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Work closely with Digital Marketing teams to optimize campaign performance across channels. Drive initiatives that improve lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue contribution. Performance & ROI Management Establish performance metrics and KPIs for trade marketing campaigns and activations. Track campaign effectiveness, conversion performance, customer acquisition metrics, and return on investment. Analyze marketing and sales data to identify trends, opportunities, and improvement areas. Prepare performance reports and recommendations for management review. Stakeholder & Partner Management Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external marketing partners. Coordinate with destination operators, tourism partners, agencies, and commercial teams to ensure successful campaign execution. Support negotiation and implementation of co-marketing opportunities with strategic partners. Ensure alignment of marketing activities with broader business objectives. Education Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field. Experience 5-7 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Marketing, Destination Marketing, Commercial Marketing, or Consumer Marketing. Experience in developing and executing go-to-market strategies and promotional campaigns. Experience managing marketing performance, conversion optimization, and ROI reporting. Experience within tourism, entertainment, hospitality, retail, travel, leisure, or destination marketing sectors is preferred.

43098440350730ee.company_name: شركة الحاج عبدالله على رضا وشركاه
43098440350730ee.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحاج عبدالله على رضا وشركاه عن كاتب حفظ ملفات للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تنظيم وتصنيف وحفظ المراسلات والوثائق لضمان سهولة الوصول إليها وإدارتها بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال حفظ الملفات أو إدارة الوثائق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص وتصنيف الكتب والمراسلات والإيصالات والفواتير والرسوم والبيانات وغيرها من الأوراق والوثائق المراد حفظها، وفرزها بناءً على نوعها وطبيعتها. تصنيف المكاتبات والمراسلات وفقاً للموضوع أو الترتيب الأبجدي أو أي نظام حفظ معتمد آخر. وضع المواد المراد حفظها في الملفات المخصصة لها وترتيب الملفات على الرفوف أو داخل الخزائن بطريقة منظمة. استخراج الوثائق المحفوظة وتسليمها للجهات المعنية عند الطلب، مع الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المتبعة. الاحتفاظ بفهارس أو بطاقات فهرسة للملفات بطريقة منظمة، والمحافظة على سلامة هذه الفهارس والوثائق. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال حفظ الملفات أو إدارة الوثائق. القدرة على تصنيف وتنظيم كميات كبيرة من الوثائق بدقة وفعالية. الإلمام بأنظمة الحفظ المختلفة (أبجدية، رقمية، حسب الموضوع). المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بالسرية والحفاظ على أمن الوثائق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في شركة الحاج عبدالله على رضا وشركاه. تقع الوظيفة في منطقة القصيم، مع إمكانية العمل في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

436078308ecc461f.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking a Principal Architect Airport to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This is a full-time, site-based position requiring a proactive architect with a strong aviation background. The role involves leading architectural and interior design delivery while ensuring coordinated oversight across various specialist design interfaces. Key Responsibilities Lead architectural and interior design across all project stages, from concept through detailed design and delivery. Provide technical and design leadership for airport modernisation, refurbishment, and expansion programmes. Represent the architecture discipline in client meetings, design workshops, technical reviews, and submissions. Make discipline-level design decisions and proactively respond to multidisciplinary coordination requirements. Coordinate with lead architects, interior designers, landscape, façade, and specialist design teams, including lighting. Develop terminal layouts that support efficient passenger flows, operational requirements, and appropriate levels of service. Integrate local cultural considerations, placemaking, and wayfinding principles to enhance regional identity and passenger experience. Ensure designs comply with applicable building codes, fire and life safety requirements, accessibility standards, and relevant aviation requirements. Develop design and phasing strategies for works within live operational airport environments, focusing on minimising disruption to passengers and airport operations. Review architectural drawings, specifications, and design deliverables for quality, durability, constructability, and suitability for high-traffic airport environments. Coordinate architectural interfaces with structural, MEP, ICT, landscape, façade, and specialist airport systems. Provide architectural oversight across interior design and specialist design interfaces, ensuring an integrated design approach. Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to resolve design and coordination issues throughout project delivery. Provide technical guidance, design reviews, and mentoring to architectural team members. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience is required. Candidates must possess a strong background in aviation projects. Work Environment This position is site-based, requiring a proactive approach to project delivery within live operational airport environments.

436aad5b289e80ed.description: About the Role Nestlé KSA is seeking a Field Sales Representative to manage and deliver sales within a designated area. This full-time position focuses on achieving short and long-term performance objectives by developing strong relationships with customers and retail personnel. The role covers the Al Qassim Area, and candidates should reside in the Al Khobar and Dammam Area. Role Purpose and Focus The primary objective of this role is to deliver overall value of retail (VOR), encompassing sales, displays, new item distribution, and core product availability. Key activities include managing Nestlé items, addressing systemic out-of-stock issues, ensuring rapid distribution of new products, optimizing shelf share, maintaining price compliance, and executing promotional sales strategies. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with customers to ensure product knowledge through in-person and phone communication. Sell incremental volume for displays and secure maximum support for promoted products. Identify and sell additional products based on observed market opportunities. Work with targeted customers to create and execute business reviews aimed at driving volume. Manage financial resources responsibly. Ensure timely payment collection from customers. Verify compliance with pricing guidelines at the retail level. Report competitive price changes and promotional support, and resolve related pricing issues. Identify and correct product voids, ensuring the availability of new items. Merchandise products to achieve schematic compliance, rotate stock, manage unsellable products, and resolve systemic out-of-stock and void problems. Develop and maintain effective relationships with department and store-level personnel to maximize sales results. Communicate market insights from the retail level to management. Required Qualifications and Skills Excellent customer service, organizational skills, and attention to detail. Strong communication (oral and written), selling, and analytical skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and other POS systems. Ability to analyze financial, inventory, retail conditions, and other data to apply appropriate selling techniques. Support operations across multiple sites, including remote work and on-site visits as required. Collaborate in the setup and operational readiness of the Center during the pre-opening phase. Ensure all activities and services meet professional and operational standards post-opening. Manage daily retail operations in line with company policies and procedures, maintaining accurate records of transactions and inventory. Implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction, increase sales, and improve profitability. Ensure effective merchandising of products to optimize visual appeal and revenue. Capability to develop a thorough understanding of retail products, services, and activities. Proficiency in managing records, reporting, and administrative tasks. Strong communication skills to liaise effectively with guests, internal teams, and external stakeholders. Commitment to promoting a safe, clean, and organized working environment. 43da5407eb04a009.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المنشآت السعودية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والمساعدة في الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم المعمارية لمشاريع الإنشاءات المختلفة. إدارة فريق التصميم في عملية اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات الفنية والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشاريع الإنشاءات ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل المباني القائمة. معرفة بأسس ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المنشآت السعودية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع فرق العمل والمقاولين لضمان تنفيذ التصاميم بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريقنا في شركة المنشآت السعودية.

These products include smart energy meters, circuit breakers (MCB / MCCB / ACB), LV & MV instrument transformers, LV & MV switchgear solutions (up to 36 kV), distribution & power transformers (up to 10 MVA), and FRP meter boxes & feeder pillars. All products are internationally type-tested and supported by engineering expertise and certified quality systems (ISO 9001 & ISO 45001). The Role: HR Business Partner MEMF Electrical Industries Co. is seeking an HR Business Partner to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves partnering with business leaders to develop and implement HR strategies that align with organizational goals and business objectives. The HR Business Partner will provide guidance and support across various HR functions, contributing to organizational development and employee experience. Key Responsibilities Partner with business leaders and managers to understand business needs and provide effective HR solutions. Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with organizational goals and business objectives. Provide guidance and support on employee relations, performance management, organizational development, and workforce planning. Support managers in handling employee relations matters and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable labor regulations. Lead and support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, and development plans. Identify talent needs and collaborate with management on recruitment, succession planning, and talent development initiatives. Analyze HR metrics and workforce data to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Support organizational change initiatives and contribute to enhancing employee engagement and organizational culture. Work closely with the Talent Acquisition team to ensure effective workforce planning and recruitment strategies. Develop and implement employee engagement and retention initiatives. Ensure consistent application of HR policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization. Provide coaching and guidance to managers on people management and HR-related matters. 43e1db5fbbda8a9a.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a General Cashier to join its team in Saudi Arabia. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Process supplier invoices and employee reimbursements accurately and in a timely manner. Monitor and reconcile vendor statements, identify outstanding items, and assist in resolving discrepancies. Schedule and execute payments to vendors according to agreed terms, while supporting cash flow requirements. Maintain accounts payable systems and records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies and audit standards. Assist with accruals and invoice tracking to support the month-end financial close process. Address vendor and internal inquiries promptly and professionally, escalating issues as necessary. Prepare documentation and support internal and external audit processes as required. Acting with Integrity and upholding ethical standards. The ability to inspire others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork leads to optimal results. A sense of Ownership and accountability for tasks. A focus on the Now, demonstrating urgency and discipline in daily work. 43134c682c6e21fc.description: About Assystem and the Role Assystem is an international engineering company focused on accelerating the global energy transition. With 6,500 professionals across 12 countries, Assystem provides engineering, project management, and digital services for complex infrastructure projects, particularly in highly regulated sectors. The company is a leader in nuclear engineering, committed to developing viable, efficient, and reliable energy solutions. This Sr. Leading Architect role is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, requiring 5-10 years of experience. Architectural Discipline Leadership The Sr. Leading Architect will lead the architectural team across assigned projects, providing technical direction, mentoring, and support. This includes allocating activities, monitoring design productivity, and ensuring consistent design standards and engineering practices. The role also involves supporting recruitment, professional development, and maintaining high standards of architectural design quality and documentation. Key Responsibilities in Design Management and Development Lead and oversee architectural design development for buildings, infrastructure, and master planning projects, from concept and feasibility studies through detailed architectural design. Manage space planning, functional planning, schematic design, and design development. Coordinate interior architectural elements, building envelope, façade design, and external works. Ensure appropriate development and technical review of architectural plans, elevations, sections, schedules, and specifications. Lead the preparation and review of design deliverables, including Design Basis Reports, concept and detailed design packages, and tender documentation. Regulatory Compliance and Coordination Ensure architectural designs comply with the Saudi Building Code, Saudi Civil Defense requirements, accessibility regulations, and local authority requirements. Apply international standards (IBC, NFPA, ICC, ISO, BS/BS EN, ASTM) where consistent with project and Saudi requirements, identifying and resolving any conflicts. Lead technical coordination with relevant Saudi authorities and municipalities, managing submissions, responding to comments, and monitoring approval status. Coordinate architectural requirements with multidisciplinary engineering teams (Structural, Civil, MEP, Fire & Life Safety, Telecom, Landscape, Interior Design, etc.) to ensure integrated designs. BIM, Technical Assurance, and Stakeholder Interface Lead BIM implementation within the architectural discipline, coordinating with BIM Managers and participating in clash-detection reviews. Perform technical reviews, interdisciplinary design reviews, and participate in technical assurance and project gateway reviews. Represent the architectural discipline in client meetings, presenting design concepts and responding to technical comments. Provide support during tender and construction phases, including reviewing technical submissions, contractor proposals, and resolving site issues. Value Engineering and Sustainability The role involves identifying opportunities to optimize architectural design solutions, evaluating alternatives based on CAPEX, OPEX, functionality, constructability, durability, and maintainability. The Sr. Leading Architect will promote sustainable and energy-efficient architectural solutions, support low-carbon objectives, and encourage innovative approaches while maintaining technical and commercial feasibility.

433b3762aa4b1635.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن ميكانيكي مصاعد للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فحص وصيانة وتصليح المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة والمقاعد الهوائية والأرصفة المتحركة لضمان سلامتها وكفاءتها التشغيلية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد الأضرار التي لحقت بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة أو المعطوبة، واختبار المعدات بعد تصليحها لضمان الأداء السليم. تفكيك المعدات لإجراء التحسينات الأساسية وإعادة تجميعها، وتوفير الأجزاء المطلوبة لعمليات الصيانة. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة الخاصة بخدمات المعدات وتصليحها. اتباع جميع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في صيانة وتصليح المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة. فهم قوي للمبادئ الميكانيكية والكهربائية المتعلقة بأنظمة المصاعد. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الإصلاحات بكفاءة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتعامل مع التحديات التقنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأوقات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة محايل بمنطقة عسير. سيعمل الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة وتشغيل المعدات لضمان أعلى مستويات الأداء والسلامة. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل.

4358ade62fcff4af.description: About the Role SAB is seeking a Regulatory Quality Assurance Manager to join the Financial Quality Assurance Department in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the accuracy and completeness of regulatory reporting across the bank. Key Responsibilities Manage and continuously improve the standardized Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance Framework across all Finance and non-Finance departments responsible for key Central Bank reports. Review and update testing methodologies, control checklists, and validation templates to assess report accuracy and completeness. Oversee procedures for identifying, escalating, and remediating errors and control weaknesses prior to submission. Ensure QA reviews are properly documented, traceable, and compliant with audit and regulatory standards. Conduct regular and thematic QA reviews on all key Central Bank reports, specifically including the quarterly Q17 Basel Return. Perform data lineage validation, verifying consistency between source systems, financial ledgers, and regulatory templates. Test the operational effectiveness of key reporting controls and recommend remediation actions. Track and follow up on corrective actions to ensure sustainable control improvements. Partner with Regulatory Reporting, Risk, Compliance, and business units to embed the QA process into the overall reporting cycle. Act as the first point of contact for internal and external audit reviews related to regulatory reporting controls. Prepare regular reporting and dashboards for senior management and the Central Bank on QA outcomes, control issues, and remediation progress. Coordinate with the Data Management Office to ensure compliance with the bank’s data governance policies. Actively contribute to a high-performing team environment through knowledge sharing, peer collaboration, and supporting team goals. Promote a culture of accountability, control excellence, and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Requirements Prior experience in Finance, Regulatory Reporting, or Internal Controls within the banking sector. Strong understanding of Central Bank regulatory requirements, prudential reporting standards, and governance expectations. Proven experience in control assurance, audit, or quality review roles. Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and operates within a collaborative team environment focused on maintaining high standards of financial quality assurance. Company Overview SAB is committed to upholding robust financial quality assurance standards and compliance with regulatory requirements. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply.

435a5b7579d2ce70.description: Cohorts: June (yearly) | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build About us Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. There's no playbook for that; our Tamarians are writing it as we go, and we believe potential should be stretched early. The Flagship Builders Program is our gateway for brilliant minds ready to kick-start their careers. Whether you're a recent graduate or early in your career with up to two years of experience, this is where you'll do real meaningful work, alongside some of the most ambitious people in the region. This year, we’re keeping things simple: one application gets you into the running for any area you’re interested in. Just share a bit about yourself, highlight what you’re great at, and tell us which teams get you excited. We want you to work on what you’re passionate about, so we’ll look at your interests to match you with a role where you can jump in and start building. Where You Could Build Product: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn builds products people actually love. You'll support Product Managers in shaping features used by millions of shoppers, drawing on data and customer insight to explore areas for improvement, conceptualise new products, and dive into a wide range of financial services, from personal banking to brand new fintech solutions. Engineering: Write code that ships. As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside senior engineers on live projects, from feature builds to system improvements, gaining mentorship and real production experience from day one. Design: Help design the experiences behind a product millions of people trust with their money. You'll contribute to real flows and interfaces, working closely with Product and Engineering to build seamless fintech solutions. You will dive directly into uncovering user needs, mapping out core user journeys, and rapidly iterating through wireframes. Data: Get hands-on with the numbers behind millions of transactions. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions. Commercial: Our Commercial teams cover two sides of the same goal: Sales, where you'll help find, pitch, and sign new merchant partners, and Account Management, where you'll help look after existing partners and grow those relationships over time. Marketing: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn tells its story. You'll support brand, growth, and campaign work that reaches customers and merchants across the region. Finance & Accounting: Get inside the financial engine of a unicorn. You'll support month-end close, financial reporting, and audits, learning what it takes to keep a fast-scaling company's numbers accurate and controlled. Strategy: Work close to the top. You'll contribute to market research, competitor benchmarking, and strategic projects that inform decisions made by Tamara's executive team: real exposure to strategic thinking at the highest level. Note: The functions listed above aren't an exhaustive list. If you're interested in an area we haven't mentioned here, tell us on your application; we still want to hear from you. What We Look For in a Builder Experience A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is desirable, but we value proven experience and capability just as highly Up to 2 years of experience, including prior internships or co-ops Passionate about continuous iteration and bringing a creative mindset to solving problems, no matter the function. Some exposure to your area of interest, through coursework, internships, or projects, is a plus, but potential matters more than a perfect CV Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a bias toward data-driven decisions Excellent communication skills, written and verbal Organisational skills: able to prioritise, multi-task, and work independently Comfortable working with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go Attributes Curious, driven, and genuinely excited to build A self-starter who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told Resilient and adaptable: you find a way through, not around, a challenge A collaborative team player who leads with empathy and respect Goal-oriented, with high personal standards and the energy to match them Why Tamara? Our teams are made up of innovators, problem-solvers, and learners. We thrive on curiosity and collaboration. If this sounds like you: curious, driven, and ready to build, we'd love to meet you. Apply now and join the next generation of Builders. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. To learn more about how we protect your privacy, please visit our Candidate Privacy Notice .

437b4dd7ff454d4b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة آشي وبشناق للمقاولات عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى تحديث بياناتهم والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة بفعالية عند وجودها. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع المعلومات كالتوظيف والترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك إدارة الدوام والإجازات. القدرة على التعامل مع شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. دقة عالية في إدخال البيانات وتوثيق المعلومات. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية، ويسهم في ضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

43ed0afd7ba201d5.description: About Informa PLC and Tahaluf Informa PLC is a leading international events, digital services, and academic knowledge group. Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF), operates as the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia. Tahaluf is known for organising large-scale events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East, contributing significantly to the global events sector. Role Overview: Customer Service Executive (Saudi National) This is a 7-month contract position for a Customer Service Executive, based in Riyadh. The role serves as a maternity cover and is open to Saudi Nationals. The Customer Service team acts as the primary contact for all after-sales queries across Tahaluf's event portfolio, supporting exhibitors, visitors, and internal event teams. This role involves both reactive and proactive management of customer queries from initial contact through to resolution, working closely with an outsourced contact centre partner and internal stakeholders. Core Responsibilities: Service Delivery and Portfolio Support Act as a Customer Service Subject Matter Expert for an assigned portfolio of events, ensuring queries are answered and resolved within departmental SLAs. Support operational readiness for assigned events by ensuring FAQs, knowledge base content, and key information are current for the outsourced contact centre partner across multiple channels. Monitor incoming queues and assist with workload coordination, identifying backlogs and SLA risks. Handle customer escalations, coordinating with internal teams for resolution. Proactively follow up on internal responses required to resolve customer enquiries within SLA. Provide support for exhibitors (show preparation, Exhibitor Manual, query resolution) and visitors (event website, registration, attendance). Offer first-line technical support for customer-facing digital products and platforms. Capture and maintain accurate customer and case information within Salesforce Service Cloud and other platforms. Support onsite Customer Service delivery and coordination during exhibitions and events. Build relationships with internal event portfolio stakeholders and participate in event planning meetings. Support the development of integrated customer communication plans and gather feedback on new launches. Identify recurring customer issues and propose improvements to processes, platforms, or communications. Deputise for the Team Leader on specific operational activities as required. Reporting, Quality, and Continuous Improvement Support the preparation of monthly CX performance reports, including SLA performance, volumes, contact drivers, and campaign outcomes. Analyse case data to identify recurring contact drivers and recommend improvements to FAQs, knowledge content, and internal processes. Assist in maintaining the case classification taxonomy across Salesforce and telephony platforms. Conduct regular quality assurance reviews across various communication channels in line with the department's QA framework. Analyse QA results to identify quality, knowledge, or training gaps and support the implementation of corrective actions. Provide evidence of recurring issues, including frequency and potential impact, to support continuous service improvement. Work Arrangement This is a 7-month contract role that can be performed remotely. Relocation or sponsorship support is not available for this position.

43ee3ede8b9e6b63.description: About the Role Marriott Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Guest Experience Expert to join their team. This full-time role focuses on creating memorable and unique experiences for guests, extending beyond standard check-in and check-out procedures. The Guest Experience Expert will guide guests throughout their entire stay, taking initiative to deliver a wide range of services. Complete necessary reports and documentation. Share highlights and information about the local area with guests. Ensure transactions are integrated seamlessly into the overall guest experience. Professional Standards and Conduct Maintain a safe work environment for all. Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Uphold confidentiality regarding company and guest information. Protect company assets from loss or damage. Ensure consistent adherence to quality standards. Present a professional appearance, including uniform, personal grooming, and communication. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to deliver thoughtful, heartfelt, and forward-thinking service. Demonstrated initiative in delivering guest services.
